claim_text: People with known kidney disease should obtain individualized clinical review before using creatine; renal status and interpretation of creatinine-based kidney markers require clinical context.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent unsafe supplementation and ensure clinical context is considered.

population.other_context: People with kidney disease considering creatine.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and supplemental sources; verify exact product form and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Exercise and Athletic Performance fact sheet summarizes creatine use and safety; renal-specific assessment remains necessary.
limitations: This claim does not establish universal contraindication or safety in all kidney conditions.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
